contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES VESP AVG P M

A silver denarius of Vespasian dating from AD 72 - 73 (Reece period 4). Reverse legend probably reads AVGVR/TRI POT. Reverse shows Priestly implements. Mint is Rome. Compare RIC II, p. 83, no. 356.
